extracted.intended_audience: readers, potential contributors, advertisers, press, and job applicants seeking information about The Onion's policies and contacts
extracted.subtask_description: Organizational FAQ and policy summary describing The Onion's submission rules, contact points, licensing and legal positions, advertising and careers procedures, archive access, and other site-use guidelines.

rubrics_metrics.name: No outside submissions
rubrics_metrics.description: No, The Onion does not accept outside submissions of any kind. We will not respond to any unsolicited submissions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Unsolicited story ideas, articles, or other content will not be accepted or answered.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unsolicited résumés not accepted
rubrics_metrics.description: Please do not send résumés unless specifically told to do so in a job listing. Any unsolicited résumés will be immediately discarded.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only apply through posted job listings on the Careers page; do not send résumés by email otherwise.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unsolicited bulk email filtered
rubrics_metrics.description: Please note that unsolicited bulk email, email attachments, and junk email of any kind are not accepted, and will be filtered and immediately discarded upon receipt.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not send bulk or attachment-laden emails to The Onion; expect automatic filtering and deletion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Technical support procedure
rubrics_metrics.description: To report a technical issue with TheOnion.com, please submit a request through the Kinja support center with a summary of the issue and your browser information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide browser details and a clear issue summary via the Kinja support center rather than emailing site staff directly for technical problems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Feedback submission and response policy
rubrics_metrics.description: Please send all concerns to publicfeedback@theonion.com. The Onion cannot guarantee a response to any feedback to its content.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Feedback is accepted at the publicfeedback address but a reply is not guaranteed; use that channel for article concerns.

rubrics_metrics.name: Legal stance on lawsuits and satire
rubrics_metrics.description: Please do not do that. The First Amendment protects satire as a form of free speech and expression.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Onion asserts satire protection under the First Amendment as its legal defense; this is their public position regarding threatened suits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of names in stories
rubrics_metrics.description: The Onion uses invented names in all of its stories, except in cases where public figures are being satirized. Any other use of real names is accidental and coincidental.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Writers typically invent names; real names only appear when satirizing public figures; incidental real-name matches are unintentional.

rubrics_metrics.name: Age recommendation
rubrics_metrics.description: The Onion is not intended for readers under 18 years of age.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Content is aimed at adult readers; minors are not the intended audience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Privacy policy location
rubrics_metrics.description: To read The Onion’s privacy policy, please click here.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Privacy practices are detailed in a separate policy linked from this page; consult that document for data use details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Advertising inquiry procedure
rubrics_metrics.description: Please send all advertising inquiries to advertising@theonion.com. Please specify the business you would like to advertise, and the appropriate advertising sales representative will get back to you promptly.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include business details when contacting advertising; consult the Media Kit for more information about opportunities and specifications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Speaking engagement requests
rubrics_metrics.description: The writers and editors ... are available for speaking engagements ... Please send all inquiries to press@theonion.com.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the press contact for booking appearances, lectures, or panels; availability is coordinated via press@theonion.com.

rubrics_metrics.name: Archive access and pre-1996 requests
rubrics_metrics.description: This website contains all of The Onion’s articles published from early 1996 through the present. For requests for articles and graphics from past issues, including those published before 1996, send to archive@theonion.com.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Browse the online archive by topic/tags/authors; submit specific archive or pre-1996 requests to the archive contact; The Onion will attempt to answer but cannot guarantee a response.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reprint and licensing restriction
rubrics_metrics.description: The Onion may not be reprinted or retransmitted in whole or in part without the express written consent of the publisher. To license material from The Onion, please send a request to permissions@theonion.com.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All republication requires written permission obtained via the permissions contact; do not reprint without consent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Careers posting procedure
rubrics_metrics.description: Onion Inc. regularly posts new openings on the Careers section of our website. On the exceedingly rare occasions that there are openings for editorial positions, those opportunities will be posted on our Careers page as well.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Monitor the Careers page for openings; do not expect editorial hiring by direct submission outside posted listings.
